question: Who among the following became the first woman, and only the third cricketer ever, to appear at six ICC Women's Cricket World Cups in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Mithali Raj**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mithali Raj became** the first woman cricketer to play six ICC World Cups** in 2022.
 
• **She first played the World Cup in the year 2000 **and followed in 2005, 2009, 2013, 2017, and finally in 2022.
 
• She is the first female cricketer to do so. Apart from her, two other cricketers (male) have achieved this feat: **Sachin Tendulkar and Javed Miandad**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** first Women's ODI Cricket World Cup was played in 1973**.
 
• **England Women's Team won the first World Cup** (Women's World Cup).
 
• **Australia Women's Team has won seven World Cups** so far, the most.
 
• **Indian Women's Team** has reached the finals two times but **never won.**
